mechanism: State the trade-off as two measurable parameters, map to the 39 parameters, draw inventive principles, translate each into the domain
best_for: Engineering and system trade-offs where every fix costs something else
notes: Physical contradictions try the four separation principles first; often dissolve without the matrix

mechanism: Separate the opposing demands in time, space, whole-vs-part, or by condition
best_for: One parameter must hold two opposite values at once
notes: Fastest TRIZ path; try before the matrix

mechanism: Biologize the function, find biological champions, extract the mechanism, translate back, test against Life's Principles
best_for: Resource, resilience, scaling, and self-organizing problems
notes: Mechanism transfers; organism does not. Label metaphor-only translations

mechanism: Make the familiar strange through direct, personal, symbolic and fantasy analogies, then force-fit the most alien one
best_for: Concept origination when the space feels empty
notes: Personal analogy feels silly and is the highest-yield of the four

mechanism: Name the dominant idea, break it with PO provocations, apply movement rather than judgement, random entry, concept fan
best_for: Every idea is a variant of the same idea
notes: Movement not judgement is the whole discipline; evaluating provocations kills the method

mechanism: Decompose into independent parameters, enumerate options, cross-consistency filter, harvest non-obvious configurations
best_for: Many independent design knobs, unclear which combination wins
notes: Cross-consistency pass is mandatory or the space explodes

mechanism: List every assumption, invert each, rebuild on the inverted foundation
notes: Cheap opener before a deeper method

mechanism: Ask how to guarantee failure, then invert each failure mode into a requirement
best_for: Teams that critique better than they create
notes: Also doubles as a risk register

mechanism: Impose an absurd constraint (10x cheaper, one page, no server, offline only) and solve under it
best_for: Solutions that have grown fat and undifferentiated
notes: Constraints produce more novelty than freedom does

mechanism: Strip to physical or economic bedrock, discard every inherited practice, rebuild from truth
notes: Expensive; use when the trade-off may be an artifact of legacy, not physics
